title: Chummer6 Flagship Promo
source_claim: 12 freshly rerendered MagicFit flagship scene clips with no generated product-name text, scene-timed trailer voiceover, and separate ork newsroom voice

scene_narration.caption: Stop losing the run between sheets, tabs, and side notes.
scene_narration.narration: You know this table. Three PDFs open. A runner sheet half finished. The GM asking who actually has the medkit.

scene_narration.caption: Chummer6 brings the table back into one command view.
scene_narration.narration: Chummer6 pulls the noise into one command view, so the crew can stop hunting for answers and start the run.

scene_narration.caption: Build runners with gear, magic, cyberware, and consequences in sight.
scene_narration.narration: Build the runner like a runner: gear, magic, cyberware, contacts, limits, and the little choices that get you paid or killed.

scene_narration.caption: Know why the numbers changed before the dice hit the table.
scene_narration.narration: When a number moves, you can follow it. No table argument. No mystery math. Just the sheet doing what it should.

scene_narration.caption: Black Ledger lets the city remember what the crew did.
scene_narration.narration: Then the city answers back. Black Ledger tracks heat, districts, jobs, factions, and the consequences your crew left behind.

scene_narration.caption: Prep scenes, NPCs, jobs, handouts, and fallout without rummaging.
scene_narration.narration: For the GM, prep becomes playable: scenes, NPCs, handouts, opposition, rewards, downtime, and next-session hooks in reach.

scene_narration.caption: Table Pulse turns rising heat into playable pressure.
scene_narration.narration: Table Pulse turns pressure into something the table can use: rising heat, hard choices, and moments that feel alive.

scene_narration.caption: Remote players can still push the run forward.
scene_narration.narration: Remote players are still in the run. They can react, answer, vote, and push the story forward without derailing the room.

scene_narration.caption: Karma Forge keeps house rules table-ready and reversible.
scene_narration.narration: Karma Forge keeps house rules from becoming folklore. Try the change, show the impact, roll it back if the table hates it.

scene_narration.caption: A field report turns aftermath into the next hook.
scene_narration.narration: We have a developing situation. The crew is gone, the drones are confused, and one fixer is suddenly unavailable for comment.

scene_narration.caption: Desktop, tablet, and phone keep the crew in sync.
scene_narration.narration: Desktop, tablet, phone, home table or remote night: the campaign stays with the crew.

scene_narration.caption: When the trace hits 100, the crew is already gone.
scene_narration.narration: Chummer6 is for crews who want the next run ready before the heat cools. Build the runner. Run the table. Let the city remember.
